description: Requires the connected Fold account. For short-term-rental hosts: schedules linen pickups for several guest checkouts at once across the host's saved addresses (up to 10). Each item: addressId (from get_my_account), checkoutDate (pickup day), pickupWindow, optional nextCheckInDate (return day; default the day after checkout) and notes. With confirm=false (default) nothing is scheduled: the response previews every item and flags problems. With confirm=true each valid item is scheduled as a real order on the card on file (same rules as book_my_pickup). Returns are in the evening; same-day turnovers rely on a second linen set at the property.

confirm.description: false (default) = preview only; true = schedule every valid item.

idempotencyKey.description: UUID recommended. Retrying a confirmed call with the same key returns the same orders.

nextCheckInDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD next guest check-in = return day. Default: day after checkout.

notes.description: For this pickup only, e.g. "2 king sets + 6 bath towels".

pickupWindow.description: Pickup window label for that market.

name: schedule_turnovers
title: Schedule rental turnovers
